name: Myanmar
value: Junta seizes 11 posts; Kachin clashes go on
summary: Junta says it took 11 resistance positions since early Nov; KIA captured 3 outposts near Maw Luu amid airstrikes
state: The military said on 11 Nov it had seized 11 positions from PDF, NUG and KNU forces since early November, including a NUG regional command (Myanmar Now). The Kachin Independence Army and allied PDF captured three junta outposts south of Maw Luu on the Sagaing–Kachin border after attacks from 4 Nov, with civilian casualties reported from airstrikes on nearby villages (Myanmar Now, 10 Nov). No major city has changed hands and no new mass-casualty airstrike was found as of 12 Nov, so the signal stays at Watch.
for_you: UK travellers should check FCDO travel advice for Myanmar, which advises against travel to much of the country. Exposure is mainly through displacement and border trade with Thailand, China and India.
rubric_hit: Civil war at sustained intensity (Watch); no major city fallen or new mass-casualty airstrike (Alert line)

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.
